question: In the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, the Planning Commission targeted reducing the gender gap in literacy to _________ percentage points by 2011-2012.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Eleventh Five-Year Plan of India (2007–2012) aimed at reducing the gender gap in literacy to **10 percentage points** by 2011-2012.
 
• The focus on reducing the gender gap in literacy was part of a broader strategy for achieving inclusive growth and social equity during the plan period.
 
• Programs like **Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA)** and **National Literacy Mission (NLM)** were strengthened to address the disparity in literacy rates between men and women.
 
• According to the 2011 Census, the literacy rate in India was 82.14% for males and 65.46% for females, with a gender gap of approximately 16.68 percentage points, showing progress but still falling short of the target.
 
• The literacy gap reduction was seen as a critical step toward empowering women and fostering gender equality in various socio-economic domains.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gender Gap in Literacy:**

 
 
• The gender gap in literacy refers to the difference in literacy rates between males and females in a population.
 
• Reducing this gap is crucial for achieving gender equality and empowering women, as literacy impacts education, employment, and social status.
 
 
 
• **Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA):**
 
 
• A flagship program launched in 2001 aimed at universalizing elementary education in India.
 
• It focuses on providing access to quality education for all children, including girls, marginalized groups, and rural populations.
 
 
 
• **National Literacy Mission (NLM):**
 
 
• Established in 1988, the NLM aimed to make 80 million adults literate by 1995, with a special focus on reducing gender disparities in literacy.
 
• The mission targeted women in rural areas and disadvantaged communities to improve overall literacy rates.
 
 
 
• **Eleventh Five-Year Plan (2007–2012):**
 
 
• The plan emphasized "faster and more inclusive growth," with a focus on education, health, and social equity.
 
• It aimed at increasing enrollment rates in education, reducing dropout rates, and addressing gender disparities in literacy and employment.
